(3) The Minister shall, prior to nominating a person as a
member of the Commission, satisfy himself that such person
has no financial or other conflict of interest in the affairs of
the  Commission,  as  is  likely  to  affect  adversely  the
discharging of his functions as a member of the Commission.

endeavor  to  ensure  that  such  nominations  reflect  the
pluralistic  character  of  the  Sri  Lankan  society  including
gender.
